lrb-certiorari-quasi-judicial-land-use: A real case, with the real names and case numbers kept: *Spahhn v. Lee County*, No. 24-CA-1479 (Fla. 20th Cir. Ct. Oct. 2025), the order granting the residents' petition for writ of certiorari and quashing the county's rezoning (DCI2023-00011) for the Southeast Water Reclamation Facility on Alico Road ([WGCU, Nov. 10, 2025](https://www.wgcu.org/housing/2025-11-10/court-tells-lee-commissioners-no-can-do-on-alico-road-sewer-plant)). lrb-forum-non-conveniens-response: No single real case found (medium confidence); the scenario appears to be a composite. The closest match is [*Adamian v. Balash*, 2024 IL App (1st) 231876](https://www.illinoiscourts.gov/resources/9984472c-fdb6-41c2-a2a9-c4e09bc30006/file), which reversed the denial of a Cook-to-DuPage forum non conveniens transfer in an obstetric negligence case. Like the task, it involved Kane County plaintiffs, a mother who presented with decreased fetal movement, an obstetrician and her practice, and a DuPage hospital. *Adamian* is not among the uploaded authorities. The newborn's transfer to a Cook County hospital and death there, which gives the task its Cook County venue, tracks the uploaded *Bradbury v. St. Mary's Hospital of Kankakee*, 273 Ill. App. 3d 555 (1995). The 2024–2026 dates and the placeholder names (John Smith, M.D.; Safe Hospital) point to an invented fact pattern.
lrb-vicar-trial-jury-instructions: A real case, with the real names kept and the dates moved forward: *United States v. Patton*, No. 4:21-cr-00075 (S.D. Iowa) (judgment Aug. 19, 2022), aff'd, [*United States v. Mallory*, 104 F.4th 15 (8th Cir. 2024)](https://ecf.ca8.uscourts.gov/opndir/24/06/222777P.pdf), cert. denied, *Patton v. United States*, No. 24-5503 (U.S. Jan. 13, 2025). The real appeal arose from the same Des Moines mall shooting and challenged the same refused justification instruction. The Eighth Circuit held that Patton, as a felon in possession of a firearm, had a duty to retreat. It relied on nearly the same authorities the task uploads (*Kehoe*, *Poe*, *Ellison*, *White Horse* and the Iowa justification statutes). The task moves the events to 2024–2026, treats Green as a co-appellant, and in assignment 2 adds *State v. Kuhse*, which the real appeal did not cite.
